.claude/rules/events.md: - 2026-10-16: A snapshot field that a reader expects once an event line is visible is written before that line is appended, never after: a reader that waits on the line and then reads the snapshot races a write made after it (the snapshot's `agent_session_id` and the `session-start` line).

.claude/rules/security.md: - 2026-11-21: A promise that a value reaches no fixture covers only what viola writes itself: before giving it, read whether the upstream CLI echoes that value into a payload `--record` keeps, since the record scrub rewrites only the home and the user word.

.claude/rules/ci.md: - 2026-11-20: A WATCH's green run read from CI counts only on the watched test's own PASS line in that job's log (`gh run view <run> --log`), never on the job's success alone: a job can pass a run that never selected the test.

.claude/rules/testing.md: - 2026-11-21: A test helper that rebuilds a `Command` from `get_program()` and `get_args()` drops every env the original set: carry `get_envs()` over, a set value and a removal alike; the red shows only under `pre-push`'s `env -i`.

.claude/rules/verification-harness.md: - 2026-11-20: A plan's non-leg entry that reads a file a round entry writes (a sha recorded before the start, read back after it) is red by construction in any block run before the round: fire the non-live entries by `--only` before the round and that entry after it, or key it to the round leg.

.claude/rules/observability.md: - 2026-09-24: `obs_event!` expands to `::tracing::event!`, so a raw-log census greps `tracing::(info|warn|error|debug|trace)!` — a bare `tracing::` grep reads the sanctioned macro in `viola_core::obs` as a raw call.
